cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
Skills 成了今天的流量中心
官方与个人合集一起涨
cover.dek: cloudflare、mattpocock、google 的 skills 仓库同日上榜，google/skills 近三天从 53 涨到 494，此前每天只有二三十。厂商、个人和垂直工作流三类都在涨。
cover.title_en:
Skills are today's biggest draw
Vendors and solo authors both climb
cover.dek_en: Skills repos from cloudflare, mattpocock and google all made the chart on the same day. google/skills went from 53 to 494 stars a day in three days, after weeks of 20 to 30.

stickers.title: 新热点
stickers.text: NVIDIA/auto-ontology 11 月 4 日见顶后连降三天,今日日增 +1,062,HN 拿到 290 分。
stickers.text_en: NVIDIA/auto-ontology peaked on Nov 4 and has slid three days in a row to +1,062. It scored 290 on HN.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Meta-Harness 持续演化后在 SWE-Bench 上从 94.0% 掉到 32.0%,相对下降 66%。
stickers.text_en: After continual evolution, Meta-Harness fell from 94.0% to 32.0% on SWE-Bench, a 66% relative drop.

stickers.title: 上下文账
stickers.text: Switch-SWE 的任务切换插件在 OpenCode 上提升 5.5 到 15.5 个百分点。
stickers.text_en: Switch-SWE's task-switching plugin lifts OpenCode by 5.5 to 15.5 percentage points.
